findings.title: The public `findMany` API was removed without a compatibility path
findings.body: `InsightsBookingService` previously exposed `findMany(findManyArgs)`, which executed an authorized Prisma query while preserving caller-supplied selection, ordering, pagination, and `where` options. It has been removed and replaced only with `getBaseConditions()`, which is not an equivalent API and does not execute a query or accept those options. Existing consumers of this service will fail TypeScript compilation on `.findMany`, and a consumer migrated only to this fragment can easily lose its previous query constraints. Keep a compatible `findMany` implementation (using the raw-condition approach internally if necessary), or migrate every production call site and preserve each caller's query semantics in this change.
